title: API Console never renders the Storage group on any host — the catalog key is `storage` while `/discovery` names the slot `file-storage`, so the fail-closed branch hides 3 endpoints
body:
> **Provenance**: moved from objectstack-ai/objectstack#7564 by the triage seat (file-at-destination, objectstack-ai/objectstack#7165 rule 1 / #7167 recreate shape — transfer API unavailable to this credential). Original filed by the QA extraction from run objectstack-ai/objectstack#7463 (framework a86db175). Original text follows, refs rewritten to full form.

## Symptom

The API Console page (`developer:api-console`, Studio → Developer → API Console) renders **no Storage group at all — on any host**, whether or not a storage service is registered and healthy.

Three endpoints are consequently unreachable from that page:

| method | path | description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/storage/upload` | Upload file (multipart/form-data) |
| GET | `/api/v1/storage/:fileId` | Download file |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/storage/:fileId` | Delete file |

**Expected:** the Storage group renders wherever the storage slot is filled and usable, exactly like the other service-gated groups (the rest of the QA item passed — the tree matched `/discovery` 10/10 and executed real 200/404/400 calls).

## Root cause

Located — a **name mismatch across the two sides of one lookup**:

- this repo's catalog declares the group under the key **`storage`** (`apps/console/src/pages/developer/hooks/useApiDiscovery.ts`, `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG` — key at `:208` on current main);
- `/discovery` reports the service under its canonical slot name **`file-storage`** (framework `packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts:27` lists `'file-storage'` as the storage-driver slot, mapped to `@objectstack/service-storage` at `:90`);
- the render loop looks the catalog key up directly in the discovery payload — `const serviceInfo = discoveredServices[serviceName]` — so it always misses, and the next line is the **fail-closed** branch: `const usable = serviceInfo ? isServiceUsable(serviceInfo) : false;` ("no entry → no endpoint group").

The fail-closed posture is correct and deliberate (ADR-0076 D12); it is the key that is wrong. The framework side is canonical — `file-storage` is the declared slot name — so the fix is the **console catalog key** in this repo, not `/discovery`.

## Reproduction

1. Boot showcase (or any host with the storage service registered) and open Studio → Developer → API Console.
2. Wait for discovery to resolve; enumerate the rendered endpoint groups.
3. Observe: no **Storage** group, on every host tried.
4. Confirm the service is really there: `GET /api/v1/discovery` reports the slot under the name `file-storage`, not `storage`.

## Triage verification (2026-08-11, objectui `origin/main` @ `5e2e9fa`)

- `useApiDiscovery.ts:208` key is `storage` (with `defaultRoute: '/api/v1/storage'` at `:210`) — present;
- `git grep file-storage -- apps/console` → 0 hits (counter-probed);
- framework slot name verified at `core-services.zod.ts:27/:90/:212` on objectstack `origin/main` @ `34c01a5`.
